intro: 10 langsat come to only about 60 kcal (estimate). Almost all the calories come from natural sugar in the flesh.
diet: Yes, langsat is one of the lighter fruits. Even 10 is still under 100 kcal. But during the season, it's easy to finish a whole bunch while lepak in front of the TV. Count first, put them in a bowl, then eat.
tips: Put 10 in a bowl instead of eating straight off the bunch.
Make it your tea-time snack at the office instead of kuih or biscuits.
Pair with a glass of low-fat milk or a boiled egg for extra protein.

swap.name: Jambu air, 5 fruits
swap.why: Watery and crunchy, so you feel full for about the same calories.

faq.q: Why does langsat sometimes taste bitter?
faq.a: Usually because you bit into the seed. Langsat seeds are bitter, so just spit them out. Unripe fruit can also taste sour and astringent.

faq.q: Are langsat, duku and dokong the same?
faq.a: All three are the same species but different varieties. Dokong usually has thicker skin, less sap and is sweeter. Langsat has thin skin and more sap.

faq.q: How do I get langsat sap off my fingers?
faq.a: Rub a bit of cooking oil on your fingers, then wash with soap. The sap comes off much easier than with water alone.
